title: JSFL: getInstanceAtPoint and getElementByIndex implementations
description:
Add two element-access methods to packages/authoring-ui/src/jsfl/runtime.ts:

1. doc.getInstanceAtPoint(x: number, y: number): any
   - Find the topmost display object whose bounding box contains the point (x, y)
   - Iterate layers from front (li=0) to back, for each layer find the governing keyframe at state.frameIndex, check each displayObject's bounds (obj.x, obj.y, obj.width ?? 100, obj.height ?? 100)
   - If a matching object is found, return its element proxy (makeElementProxy or equivalent)
   - If none found, return null
   - Add to JsflDocument interface + makeDocumentProxy

2. doc.getElementByIndex(layerIndex: number, frameIndex: number, elementIndex: number): any
   - Returns the element proxy for the display object at the given layer/frame/element indices
   - Find the governing keyframe at or before frameIndex in layers[layerIndex], return element proxy for displayObjects[elementIndex]
   - If out of bounds, return null
   - Add to JsflDocument interface + makeDocumentProxy
